name: paste_slash_task
description: Known-open bug (plan item 6.1): a pasted build-error line that starts with '/' (e.g. '/src/App.csproj : error CS0246 ...') is taken for a slash command and rejected with 'Bilinmeyen komut', so the model never sees the task. Expected behaviour: input is a command only when its first word is a registered command; anything else is a task. Fixed in 6.1 (src/commands.py).
